title: "Address wrong since October"
story: Valid-time corrections 30 days back on 1,000 subjects during live traffic.
checked: The feed reports the valid-time range; derived state is re-run; explain at the old basis still shows the old belief.
domain: derived state of each corrected subject is re-run (O-DOMAIN affected set; fails closed until EXP-D01)
reads: After the run, per corrected subject: pull at (receipt instant - 1 ms, validAt 2026-10-15) = old belief; (receipt instant, 2026-10-15) = fix; (receipt instant, 2026-09-15) = unchanged old address.

oracle.source: O-REPLAY digests at validAt NOW, 2026-10-15 and 2026-09-15
